newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia trade deficit slightly drops in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia trade deficit slightly drops in 1996.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit fell to 2.17 billion dinars ($2.17 billion) in 1996 from 2.29 billion dinars in 1995, official figures showed.
Exports amounted to 5.372 billion dinars, up by 3.8 percent from 5.173 billion dinars in 1995, and imports were worth 7.543 billion dinars, up by 1.1 percent from 7.464 billion dinars.

The figures, released by the National Institute of Statistics on Saturday, showed that exports of phosphates rose by 17.1 percent, energy by 28.9 percent, and textiles, Tunisia's main manufacturing sector export, by 6.4 percent.
